clientSelection: Only the actual OAuth client configured for the ouf-admin OUF - MCP Server connection, confirm current binding before mutations.
inspect: Client Scopes existence and Include in token scope
Only actual HUMAN client's Default/Optional scope assignments
If Optional, explicit scope request in connection
Any existing client-scope role restrictions, without removing them
Fresh HUMAN connection after configured/routed scopes corrected
minimalCorrection: Add only missing required READ scopes to that exact HUMAN client/connection after concrete IAM review; retain all existing scopes, roles, mappers, audience and security settings. Prefer client-specific assignment, never realm defaults.
secretHandling: Do not request or export bearer, refresh token, client secret, JWT or full configuration. Only names/flags of six read scopes and the verified client binding.
actualIdentitySource: Scope names seen by MCP are derived from Gateway-verified delegated HUMAN identity; observed denial does not identify whether omission occurred in client config, token issuance or Gateway projection.
newAcquisitionReadPrecondition: Evidence of corrected scope binding and genuinely new HUMAN OAuth context; policy51 still valid; one bounded read then STOP on denial, no automatic retry or expiry extension.
